mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id AS conversationId,c.title,c.status, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, (SELECT e.status FROM ai_agent_execution e WHERE e.conversation_id=c.conversation_id AND e.user_id=c.user_id AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS executionStatus FROM ai_conversation c WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.delete_flag=1 AND c.status='active' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.conversation_id AS conversationId,c.title,c.status, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, (SELECT e.status FROM ai_agent_execution e WHERE e.conversation_id=c.conversation_id AND e.user_id=c.user_id AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS executionStatus FROM ai_conversation c WHERE c.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.delete_flag=1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_execution e JOIN ai_agent_execution r ON e.parent_execution_id=r.id SET e.status='cancelled', e.error_code=CASE WHEN r.status='cancel_requested' THEN 'cancel_timeout' ELSE 'execution_timeout' END, e.finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,e.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE r.parent_execution_id IS NULL AND r.delete_flag=1 AND e.delete_flag=1 AND e.status IN ('running','cancel_requested') AND ((r.status='running' AND r.created_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL #{executionMaxAgeSeconds} SECOND)) OR (r.status='cancel_requested' AND r.updated_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL #{cancelRequestMaxAgeSeconds} SECOND)))

UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET status='cancelled', error_code=CASE WHEN status='cancel_requested' THEN 'cancel_timeout' ELSE 'execution_timeout' END, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE parent_execution_id IS NULL AND delete_flag=1 AND ((status='running' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL #{executionMaxAgeSeconds} SECOND)) OR (status='cancel_requested' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL #{cancelRequestMaxAgeSeconds} SECOND)))
UPDATE ai_conversation SET title=#{title},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE ai_conversation_message SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE ai_conversation SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1

UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET status=#{status},error_code=#{errorCode}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE parent_execution_id=#{parentExecutionId} AND delete_flag=1 AND status IN ('running','cancel_requested')
UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET agent_name=#{agentName},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND agent_name=#{currentAgentName} AND status='running' AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE ai_conversation SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
mapper.select: SELECT content,version,last_operation_id AS operationId FROM ai_memory_file WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND path=#{path} AND delete_flag=1
SELECT fingerprint,result_version AS resultVersion,existed FROM ai_memory_operation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_file SET content=#{content},version=#{version},last_operation_id=#{operationId}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE ai_memory_file SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=1
mapper.select: SELECT id,version FROM ai_memory_file WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND path=#{path} AND delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.message_id AS messageId,m.role,m.payload FROM ai_conversation_message m JOIN ai_agent_execution e ON e.id=m.agent_execution_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.delete_flag=1 AND e.delete_flag=1 AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.sequence_no

SELECT m.message_id AS messageId,m.role,m.payload,e.run_id AS runId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId FROM ai_conversation_message m JOIN ai_agent_execution e ON e.id=m.agent_execution_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.delete_flag=1 AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY m.sequence_no

SELECT e.id,e.run_id AS runId,e.conversation_id AS conversationId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId,p.run_id AS parentRunId, e.agent_name AS agentName,e.delegation_tool_call_id AS delegationToolCallId, e.task,e.status,e.error_code AS errorCode, DATE_FORMAT(e.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS finishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM ai_agent_execution e LEFT JOIN ai_agent_execution p ON p.id=e.parent_execution_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.parent_execution_id IS NULL AND e.status IN ('running','cancel_requested') AND e.delete_flag=1 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.id,e.run_id AS runId,e.conversation_id AS conversationId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId,p.run_id AS parentRunId, e.agent_name AS agentName,e.delegation_tool_call_id AS delegationToolCallId, e.task,e.status,e.error_code AS errorCode, DATE_FORMAT(e.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS finishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM ai_agent_execution e LEFT JOIN ai_agent_execution p ON p.id=e.parent_execution_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY e.created_at,e.id

SELECT e.id,e.run_id AS runId,e.conversation_id AS conversationId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId,p.run_id AS parentRunId, e.agent_name AS agentName,e.delegation_tool_call_id AS delegationToolCallId, e.task,e.status,e.error_code AS errorCode, DATE_FORMAT(e.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS finishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM ai_agent_execution e LEFT JOIN ai_agent_execution p ON p.id=e.parent_execution_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND e.run_id=#{runId} AND e.delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE

UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET status='cancel_requested',error_code=COALESCE(error_code,#{reason}), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='running' AND delete_flag=1

UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET status=#{status},error_code=#{errorCode}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=1 AND status IN ('running','cancel_requested')
